records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically its second and third quarter financial results have reflected higher travel demand, and were better than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021, the Company recognized approximately $1.9 billion and $0.7 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company has seen increasing demand for travel both domestically and in countries where entry is permitted; however, as the situation surrounding the COVID-19 pandemic remains fluid, the pandemic has continued to negatively impact travel demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have reduced our capacity as we managed through the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, and our capacity in 2022 remained lower than capacity prior to the pandemic, resulting in a significant reduction to our revenue through the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Relative to the first quarter of 2019, the Company operated approximately 81% of its capacity for the first quarter of 2022 compared to approximately 46% of its capacity in the first quarter of 2021.
